subject: Request: senior authorization for nonstandard indemnity, SLA remedy, and one-time discount (HelixTech)
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@helixtech.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@helixtech.com, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@helixtech.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: HelixTech redlines — liability, indemnity, SLA remedy

Alex —

Thanks for the draft. Our legal team reviewed and attached a redline with three material asks we need to close:

1) Indemnity: HelixTech is requesting mutual indemnity for third-party IP claims and a carve-in for privacy/security incidents up to 100% of damages.

2) Liability cap: remove the standard single-digit cap; propose a cap of USD 5M or 3x annual fees, whichever is greater.

3) Warranty / SLA remedy: require SLA credits for downtime > 0.5% monthly, and a step-up remediation plan (credits + escalation + root-cause report).

We are also requesting a one-time commercial concession (15% discount year 1) in exchange for a 24-month commitment.

Attached: HelixTech_Redlines_Mar15.docx for your reference.

We'd like to get this wrapped by next Wednesday. Could you flag who at Redwood needs to sign off on the indemnity/cap changes?

Best,
Emma
Emma Jones
Lead Counsel, Contracts
HelixTech Inc.
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: HelixTech redlines — liability, indemnity, SLA remedy

Laura / Ben —

Forwarding HelixTech's redlines (attached). Summary below:
- They want mutual IP indemnity + full carve-in for security/privacy incidents.
- They've proposed raising the liability cap to $5M or 3x annual fees (whichever is greater).
- They want SLA credits for >0.5% monthly downtime and an explicit remediation path.
- Commercial ask: 15% one-time discount for year one with 24-month commitment.

My read: the discount is negotiable, finance can model. The indemnity and cap are material legal changes — I think this requires formal executive authorization (deal desk + CCO/CEO sign-off) before we commit.

Ask: Ben, can you provide a recommended fallback (compromise language) and whether a capped carve-out (exceptions for gross negligence/privacy breach only) could be acceptable? Laura, if we can offer a smaller concession on cap and a 10% discount, can you loop the buyer? Also, what's our appetite for SLA credits here (they're an enterprise prospect).

Target: respond to HelixTech by tomorrow EOD to keep momentum.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: HelixTech redlines — liability, indemnity, SLA remedy

Alex —

Thanks for the summary. This is a strategic 24-month opportunity; I want to keep the sale moving but we cannot accept open-ended indemnity or a $5M+ cap without tradeoffs.

Ben — can you propose a written alternative we can present tomorrow? If legal gives us a path that limits exposure (e.g., carve-ins limited to willful misconduct/privacy breach; cap set to the greater of $1M or 2x fees with specific exceptions), I can offer a 10% one-time discount and a tailored SLA (credits capped, clear remediation SLAs).

If legal deems that insufficient, we need an executive exception. Please advise ASAP — I'll be on a customer call at 14:00 PT but available by Slack.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Mar 2029 16:10:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: HelixTech redlines — recommendation and exec-authority request

Team —

Reviewed HelixTech redlines and drafted recommended compromise below (high-level):

1) Indemnity: mutual indemnity for IP claims; security/privacy incidents remain the customer's remedy area but include a limited indemnity for confirmed data breaches caused by Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct. We should avoid accepting indemnity for all privacy/security incidents without strict scope.

2) Liability cap: propose cap = greater of USD 1,250,000 or 3x the 12-month recurring fees, with carve-outs for liability resulting from willful misconduct and IP infringement. This balances commercial risk and keeps exposure bounded.

3) SLA & warranty remedy: offer SLA credits for monthly availability below 99.5%, capped at 50% of monthly fees in any single month and 200% across the contract term. Include a mandatory root-cause analysis and mitigation plan for any outage above the threshold.

4) Commercial concession: recommend countering with a one-time 10% discount on year 1 for a 24-month committed term. 15% is outside standard pricing authority; 10% is within deal desk limits but will need CCO sign-off if finance objects.

Rationale: these terms materially limit unlimited exposure, keep the customer commercially satisfied, and maintain a clean fallback to escalate if HelixTech insists.

Exec ask: I recommend we route this to CCO (Marissa Cole) for approval to accept the adjusted cap and the 10% discount. If CCO approves, Legal will prepare the redline. Please confirm if I should draft the compromise redline and I will attach language.

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@helixtech.com>, contracts@helixtech.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Mar 2029 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelixTech redlines — next steps and proposed compromise (pending sign-off)

Emma —

Thank you for the quick redline. We're aligned on most commercial points; there are three items that require internal sign-off on our side before we can accept final language: indemnity scope, liability cap, and the size of the one-time discount.

To keep things moving, Ben (Legal) and I discussed a potential compromise we can present as our next step:
- Indemnity: mutual IP indemnity; limited Redwood indemnity for data breaches only where there's demonstrable gross negligence or willful misconduct.
- Liability cap: greater of USD 1,250,000 or 3x annual recurring fees, with standard carve-outs for willful misconduct and IP.
- SLA remedy: credits triggered below 99.5% availability, capped per month and across term; include RCA and remediation plan obligation.
- Commercial: we can offer a one-time 10% credit for year 1 on a 24-month commitment.

Ben is drafting the exact clause language. This is contingent on final approval from our CCO; I'll loop Marissa and Laura for a stamp. If this approach works for HelixTech, can we set a short call tomorrow morning to agree in principle and then route the final redline for sign-off and countersignature?

Attachment: Proposal_HelixTech_v2.pdf (summary of concessions).

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
